description: ## This tool manages Stripe `Report` types and `Report Run` instances. `Report` types are templates for generating reports, and `Report Run`s are instances of those reports. There…

intent.description: The intent of the tool call.

params.description: The parameters for the tool call. Required parameters depend on the intent.

include.description: Used with retrieve_report_run. Results are inline under result.inline by default; pass ["result.file"] to get a downloadable file link instead.

limit.description: Used with retrieve_report_run. Maximum number of inline result rows to return. Defaults to 100, maximum 1000.

page.description: Used with retrieve_report_run. Pass the result.inline.next_page_url value from a previous response to fetch the next page of inline result rows.

report_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_type and create_report_run. The unique identifier of the `Report` object (format report_*).

report_parameters.description: Used with create_report_run. A map of parameter names to values for `Report Run` customization.

report_run_id.description: Used with retrieve_report_run. The unique identifier of the `Report Run` object (format reprun_* or rrun_*, depending on which API created it).

result_options.description: Used with create_report_run. Optional settings to customize the results.

compression.description: Compression applied to the generated file. Defaults to none.

search_string.description: Used with search_report_type. Substring to match against `Report` type names. If omitted, lists all `Report` types.

name: stripe.stripe_reports
